name: Cache reader
description: Reads keys from a Redis-compatible cache over TLS: one key's value, or the keys that match a pattern. An example of a raw adapter: Node code that opens its own TLS connection to one exact endpoint, speaks the cache's own protocol with an npm package (redis-parser, added with valet_add_dependency), and signs in with an entrusted password.

cache.description: The cache's user name and password (a read-only account is best)

tools.name: get_key
tools.title: Get key
tools.description: One key's value as text (cut at 10,000 characters), or null if the key isn't there.

tools.name: scan_keys
tools.title: Scan keys
tools.description: The keys that match a pattern (* and ? as wildcards), at most 500.
